description: Preview an Ethereum transaction WITHOUT signing it: sigil decodes the calldata to English (ERC-20/721/1155 transfers and approvals, Permit2, Uniswap swaps, multicall, plus any user ABIs) and, when a simulation RPC is configured for the chain, dry-runs it from the portal address to report status, gas, revert reason, net balance changes and approvals granted. Takes the same {portal, tx} as sigil_eth_sign_transaction. Call this before signing anything non-trivial (any calldata, approvals, swaps, or sizeable value) and show the user the `preview` text, especially its warnings, before you sign. Nothing is signed or written to the audit log. Returns {preview, headline, warnings, decoded, simulation}.

tx.description: Transaction fields. type="legacy" requires {chainId, nonce, gasPrice, gasLimit, to, value, data}. type="eip1559" requires {chainId, nonce, maxPriorityFeePerGas, maxFeePerGas, gasLimit, to, value, data, accessList?}. To deploy a contract, set to=null (explicit JSON null, not omitted) and put the creation bytecode in data. Numbers may be supplied as JSON numbers or decimal strings.

name: sigil_eth_preview_transaction
